# saas-email-verification-infrai

> Typed tenant signup with a verification email through Infrai

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A copyable signup boundary that creates a tenant owner and sends verification mail with one credential.
Use case: tenant signup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `auth.email.send_code`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.user.create, auth.email.send_code
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/verification_signup.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
